titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Crucifixion and Resurrection in the Prophets (ch. 109–110)
part: ch. 109–110 — the crucifixion and resurrection in the prophets
source: Carl Bezold, Kebra Nagast: Die Herrlichkeit der Könige (Munich, 1905), ch. 109–110 — public domain. Geʿez text as in Ran HaCohen's Unicode edition of Bezold (tau.ac.il/~hacohen/KN, from Michal Jerabek's 1995 digitization), archived and checked against Bezold's printed page. Per-sign transliteration derived mechanically from Unicode; word-level romanization auto-generated (schwa-reduced) and approximate. Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: These two short chapters continue the author's proof from the prophets: ch. 109 gathers what Moses, David, Isaiah, Solomon, Jeremiah and Zechariah said about Christ's crucifixion (Psalm 22 and 69, Isaiah 53, the speech of the wicked in the Wisdom of Solomon, Proverbs 1, the thirty pieces of silver, Zechariah 12:10), and ch. 110 does the same for the resurrection (Psalms 12, 82, 44, 68, 78 and 16, Isaiah 53 again, and Solomon's sun). Each citation is introduced by 'and as X prophesied, he said'. The quotations are the author's own wording, so the notes name a source only where the passage is clear and flag the doubtful words with (?). Dillmann's lexicon was not available for this draft.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፻፱ is the numeral 109 (፻ hundred, ፱ nine). በእንተ 'concerning' takes ስቅለቱ, ስቅለት 'crucifixion, hanging' (from ሰቀለ 'hang, crucify') with -ሁ 'his' (ስቅለት + ሁ is written ስቅለቱ: the ት and the suffix merge). The chapter is a catena of prophecies, each opened by the frame ወበከመ ተነበየ X ወይቤ 'and as X prophesied, he said'; the author's wording often fits the quotation to his purpose, and the notes say where I can name a source.

sentences.l: And-again prophesied prophets concerning crucifixion-his for-Christ, and-as prophesied Moses servant(?)-his for-God and-said: 'You-will-see saviour-your hanged upon wood, and-not you-believe in-him.'
sentences.i: And again the prophets prophesied concerning the crucifixion of Christ; and as Moses, the servant(?) of God, prophesied, he said: 'You will see your saviour hanged upon wood, and you will not believe in him.'
sentences.n: ወካዕበ 'and again' (ወ- + ካዕበ). ተነበዩ is the tä-stem perfect of ነበየ, 'they prophesied' (3mp); ተነበየ 'he prophesied' (3ms). ለክርስቶስ: ስቅለቱ takes -ሁ 'his' and ለ- names the possessor afterwards ('his crucifixion, Christ's'). ቊልዔሁ 'his servant' (ቊልዔ with -ሁ; I take it as 'servant, attendant', unconfirmed, since Dillmann was not available (?)); ለእግዚኣብሔር 'of God' by the same ለ- pattern. The saying itself: ትሬእዩ is 2mp imperfect of ርእየ 'see'; ስቁለ is the passive participle 'hanged', in the accusative after the verb; ዲበ ዕፅ 'upon wood' (ዕፅ is also 'tree'; here the wood of the cross). ቦቱ is በ + -ቱ 'in him', after ተአምኑ 'believe'. I cannot match the words to a verse; they perhaps echo Deuteronomy 28:66 about life 'hanging' before the eyes (?). The same frame ወበከመ ተነበየ returns throughout.

sentences.i: And as David prophesied, he said: 'Many dogs have seized me, and they have pierced my hands and my feet, and counted all my bones; as for them, they looked on and gazed(?) at me, and they shared out my garments among themselves, and cast lots(?) over my robe.'
sentences.n: Psalm 22:16–18 (21:17–19 in the Greek numbering): the dogs, the pierced hands and feet, the counted bones, the garments divided, the lot cast. አኀዙኒ is አኀዘ 'seize' (3mp perfect) + -ኒ 'me'; ቀነዉኒ 'they pierced me' (ቀነወ, which I read as 'pierce, bore through' (?)); the objects እደዊየ ወእገርየ 'my hands and my feet' (-የ '1cs my') are accusative. ኆለቁ is 3mp perfect of ኈለቈ 'count'. እሙንቱሰ 'they indeed' (3mp pronoun + emphatic -ሰ) turns to the onlookers; ጠዪቆሙ is a gerund 'looking' (?), and ተዐወሩኒ 'they gazed at me' is a guess (?): the only sense I know for the root ዐወረ is 'be blind' (ዕዉር), which does not fit 'gaze', so the true sense may differ (Dillmann was not available). ተካፈሉ 'they divided among themselves' (reciprocal tä-stem of ከፈለ 'divide'), ለርእሶሙ 'for themselves' (ርእስ 'head' used as 'self'). ተዓፀዉ 'they cast lots' follows the earlier glossary's guess (?); ዐራዝ I take as a garment, 'robe' (?).

sentences.i: And as Isaiah the prophet prophesied concerning the incarnation and the crucifixion of Christ, he said: 'O Lord, who believes our word? And to whom was the arm of God revealed?
sentences.n: Isaiah 53:1. ትስብእት is 'becoming human, incarnation' (from ሰብእ 'human being'), here with -ሁ 'his'. እግዚኦ 'O Lord' is the vocative of እግዚእ. መኑ 'who?'; የአምነነ is the imperfect of አምነ 'believe' with -ነ 'us' and the noun ቃልነ 'our word' in apposition, so 'who believes us, our word' (the Geʿez has both 'us' and 'our word'; the English keeps only the word). ወለመኑ 'and to whom'. ተከሥተ is the passive 'was revealed' (tä-stem of ከሠተ 'open, reveal'), and its subject is መዝራዕተ እግዚኣብሔር 'the arm of God': መዝራዕተ is the construct state (a feminine noun in -ት ends in -ተ before the noun that follows), not a loose accusative. The unit ends at a ፤ with the quotation still open.

sentences.i: We told it: like a child before him, and like a root in a dry land; he had no beauty(?) and no appearance, and his appearance was despised and lowly beyond all men;
sentences.n: Continues Isaiah 53 (verses 2–3). ነገርነ is the perfect of ነገረ 'tell' (1cp 'we told'). ከመ ሕፃን 'like a child'; በቅድሜሁ 'before him' (በ- + ቅድሜ + -ሁ); it may go with ነገርነ ('we told before him') or with the simile, and I keep the Geʿez order. ሥርው 'root, shoot'; ምድር ጽምእት 'a dry land' (ጽምእት is fem., agreeing with ምድር). አልቦ 'there is not' with ላሕየ and ራእየ in the accusative; ላሕይ 'beauty' is not certain (?). ወራእዩሂ is ራእዩ 'his appearance' (ራእይ + -ሁ) + ሂ 'and indeed'. ምኑን is the passive participle 'despised'; ወትሑት 'and humble'; እምኵሉ ሰብእ 'beyond all men' (እም- 'than' used for comparison).

sentences.i: his person is scourged and sick, for he turned his face, and they despised him and did not reckon him. And as Solomon prophesied, he said: 'Let us kill the righteous man, for he is a burden to us; he opposes our works(?), he has become a reproach(?) to our mind, and a reproach(?) became to him through our sins;
sentences.n: Isaiah 53:3 closes (ቅሡፍ 'scourged, stricken' and ሕሙም 'sick'; ብእሲሁ 'his person', ብእሲ + -ሁ). ሜጠ ገጻ 'he turned his face': ገጻ is formally ገጽ 'face' + -ሃ 'her' (the accusative would be ገጸ, and 'his' ገጹ); neither fits a masculine subject, so I take it as a slip for 'his face' (?). አስተሐቀርዎ 'they despised him' and ኢተሓሰብዎ 'they did not reckon him' (3mp perfects with -ዎ 'him'). Then Solomon, an echo of the speech of the wicked in the Wisdom of Solomon, chapter 2 (verses 12–20). ንቅትሎ ለጻድቅ: ንቅትሎ is 1cp jussive 'let us kill' + -ኦ 'him' (ንቅትል + ኦ), doubled by ለጻድቅ 'the righteous'. ክቡድ 'heavy, burdensome', ለነ 'to us'. ይትቃወሞን is odd: tä-stem of the III-stem ቃወመ (from ቆመ 'stand'), 'oppose', but the ending -ን matches no suffix I know ('us' would be -ነ); I read 'he opposes us' (?); ለምግባሪነ 'our works' (ምግባር + -ነ). መዝለፌ is a noun 'reproach' (?) (from ዘለፈ 'rebuke'), ኮነነ 'he became to us'. ሰቆራረ I cannot fix (?); 'reproach' is a guess from the parallel, and ሎቱ 'to him' makes the clause obscure. በኀጣውኢነ 'through our sins' (plural of ኀጢአት + -ነ). The unit ends at ፤.

sentences.i: And again he repeated, and said: 'My son, let wicked men not lead you astray; if they say to you: Come with us, join us; let us hide innocent blood, and let us take plunder, and let us have one purse(?) for us all;
sentences.n: Proverbs 1:10–14, the invitation of the sinners. ደገመ 'he repeated' (the same speaker, Solomon, speaks again); ወልድየ 'my son' (ወልድ + -የ). ኢያስሕቱከ is the negative jussive of አስሕተ 'lead astray' + -ከ 'you', 'may they not lead you astray'; ሰብእ ረሲዓን 'wicked men' (plural of ረሲዕ). ለእመ ይቤሉከ 'if they say to you'; ነዓ ምስሌነ 'come with us'; ተሳተፍ 'share, take part' (imperative). ንድፍን is 1cp jussive of ደፈነ, which I read as 'cover, hide, bury' (?), with ደመ ንጹሐ 'innocent blood'. በርባሮ I read as 'plunder' (?), unconfirmed; ወይኩነነ 'and let it be for us'; ቊናመተ 'purse' (?), a guess from the sense of a common fund. ለኵልነ 'for all of us' (ኵሉ + -ነ). The unit ends at ፤.

sentences.i: Hold your head back from their tracks(?), for it is not for you, what they spread out(?) for the birds: a snare.'
sentences.n: Proverbs 1:15–17. አግሕሥ is the imperative of አግሕሠ, which I read as 'withdraw, hold back' (?). አሠር 'track, trace' (?): the word can also mean a bond, but the sense 'footsteps' suits the saying, though the text says 'head' where one expects 'foot'. አኮ በከ, literally 'not in you / not yours', for 'it is not for you'. ዘይረብቡ 'what they spread (a net)' (ዘ- + imperfect, root r-b-b (?)); ለአዕዋፍ 'for birds' (plural of ዖፍ); መሥገርተ 'snare' in the accusative. The Geʿez is read as it stands.

sentences.i: and we saw him sick and wounded with pain; yet he did not open his mouth in his pain, and he came to be slaughtered like a lamb before the one who shears it; in the same way he did not open his mouth in his pain until they took his soul;
sentences.n: Isaiah 53:3, 7. ወርኢናሁ 'and we saw him' (ርኢነ 'we saw' + -ሁ). ሕሙመ ወቊሱለ 'sick and wounded' are accusatives of condition. ወውእቱሰ 'and he for his part'. ኢከሠተ አፉሁ 'he did not open his mouth' (አፍ 'mouth', አፉሁ 'his mouth'). ወመጽአ ይጠባሕ 'and he came to be slaughtered' (ይጠባሕ looks like an active imperfect of ጠብሐ 'slaughter'; the sense needs 'to be slaughtered', which I take (?); after a verb of coming it gives the purpose). ከመ በግዕ 'like a lamb'. ዘይቀርጾ is ዘ- + imperfect of ቀረጸ + -ኦ 'him/it', 'he who shears (carves?) it'; 'shears' is my reading (?). ከማሁ 'likewise'. እስከ ይነሥእዋ ለነፍሱ: ነፍስ is fem., so the suffix -ዋ 'her/it' is doubled by ለነፍሱ 'his soul'; 'until they take his soul'. Ends at ፤.

And-as prophesied Jeremiah prophet and-said: 'And-they-took price-his of-the-precious thirty silver, whom they-honoured from sons-of Israel; and-said-to-me God: Put-it into the-treasury(?), and-test-it whether it-be pure, and-give-it to the-smelters(?) for-fire;
sentences.i: On account of the sin of my people I have come as far as death. And as Jeremiah the prophet prophesied, he said: 'And they took the price of the precious one, thirty (pieces) of silver, him whom they valued, from the sons of Israel; and God said to me: Put it into the treasury(?), and test it whether it is pure, and give it to the smelters(?) for the fire;
sentences.n: The first clause continues Isaiah 53 (the speaker's 'I' is the Lord's, in the author's wording); በ- 'on account of'; በጻሕኩ is 1cs perfect of በጽሐ 'arrive, reach'; እስከ ለሞት 'as far as death'. Then Jeremiah: the quotation is the one Matthew 27:9–10 gives to Jeremiah and the Hebrew book of Zechariah has at 11:12–13 (the thirty pieces of silver), shaped here by the author. ፴ is the numeral thirty (spoken ሠላሳ, śäläsa, as the glossary decides); ብሩረ 'silver', accusative. ሤጦ is ሤጥ 'price', accusative, with -ሁ 'his'; ለክቡር 'of the precious one' (ክቡር 'precious, honoured'). ዘአክበርዎ: ዘ- + 'they honoured' (አክበረ 'honour, value') + -ዎ, 'whom they valued'; እምደቂቀ እስራኤል 'from the sons of Israel' (እም- 'from', perhaps 'some of them'; the Geʿez does not say who the valuers were). ወይቤለኒ 'and he said to me'. ደዮ 'put it' (imperative of ወደየ + -ኦ). ሕንቅርት I take as 'treasury' (?), unconfirmed; since the next words say 'test it … for the fire', a smelting vessel, 'crucible', is as likely (?). ፍትኖ 'test it' (ፈተነ). ለእመ ኮነ ንጹሐ 'whether it is pure'. ወወህብዎ 'and give it' (imperative of ወሀበ, plural); ገራህተ 'smelters' (?) is a guess from the context (testing, fire); I half-remember ገራህት as 'field, farmland', which would change the clause, and I cannot settle it without Dillmann (?). Ends at ፤.

sentences.i: As God commanded me, I speak. And as Isaiah the prophet prophesied, he said: 'They counted him with sinners, and they delivered him to death.' And as David the prophet prophesied, he said: 'Those who hate me wrongfully have multiplied, and they repaid me evil in place of good.' And as Zechariah the prophet prophesied, he said: 'They are to see him whom they hanged and pierced.'
sentences.n: This unit holds the end of Jeremiah and three more citations; it is under the length limit of about 45 words, so I did not cut it. በከመ አዘዘኒ እግዚኣብሔር እንብብ: 'as God commanded me' (አዘዘ 'command' + -ኒ) with እንብብ, 1cs imperfect of ነበበ 'speak, say', so 'I speak'. Isaiah 53:12 (and 53:8): ኆለቊዎ 'they counted him' (ኈለቈ), ምስለ ኃጥኣን 'with sinners', ወአግብእዎ ለሞት 'and they delivered him to death' (አግብአ, causative of ገብአ 'return', here 'hand over'). David: Psalm 35:19 and 38:19–20 (or 109:3–5), loosely (?); በዝኁ 'they were many' (በዝኀ), እለ ይጸልኡኒ 'those who hate me'; በዐመፃ 'in injustice'; ፈደዩኒ 'they repaid me' (ፈደየ); ህየንተ ሠናይት 'in place of good' (ሠናይት, fem. 'good'). Zechariah 12:10, the passage John 19:37 uses: ሀለዎሙ 'it is for them, they are to' + ይርአይዎ 'they see him'; ለዘሰቀልዎ is the object marker ለ- + ዘ- 'who' + ሰቀልዎ 'they hung him' (the verb of the cross), ወወግእዎ 'and they pierced him'. The ፨ ends the section.

sentences.i: And as Solomon his son prophesied, he said: 'And the sun of righteousness will rise(?), and he will circle toward the south(?), and return to his place.'
sentences.n: The quotation recalls Ecclesiastes 1:5–6, the sun that rises, circles and returns to its place, with the sun turned into Christ, the sun of righteousness (a title also in Malachi 4:2). ወልዲ is the same form as in ch. 108, taken there and here as 'his son' (David's son), but the ending is unusual and 'my son' is not excluded (?). ይትሌዐል 'he will be raised, rise' (?); ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness', construct state; ይምነ I read as 'to the right, southward' (ይምን means right hand and south) (?); የዐውድ 'he goes around' (ዐወደ); ወይገብእ 'and returns' (ገብአ), ውስተ መካኑ 'to his place' (መካን + -ሁ). The final ፨ ፨ ፨ belongs to this unit and ends the part.

glossary.ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (አዝማዲሆሙ ለእለ ኀልቁ 'the kinsmen of those who perished')
glossary.ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
glossary.ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will') · as object after ሰብሐ ('praise God', ይሴብሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር)
glossary.ለክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — of Christ, Christ's (ለ- naming the possessor after an anticipating suffix) · ለ- marking the object, doubled by the suffix on ወያመስልዎ ('they liken Christ')
glossary.ለክቡር: ክቡር — of the precious one (ለ- genitive link + adjective used as a noun)
glossary.ለኵልነ: ኵሉ — for all of us (ለ- + ኵል- + -ነ '1cp')
glossary.ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
glossary.ለዘሰቀልዎ: ሰቀለ — him whom they hanged (ለ- marking the object + ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G, s-q-l + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ለገራህተ: ገራህት (?) — to the smelters, refiners (?) (ለ- + noun ገራህት); the usual sense of the root is 'field, tiller' (?)
glossary.ለጻድቅ: ጻድቅ — the righteous (ለ- 'to' marking the object + adjective/noun)
glossary.ለጽምእየ: ጽምእ — for my thirst (ለ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ለጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — justice, righteousness (ለ- + noun; naming what suffix -ā pointed to) · ጸራ ለጽድቅ 'enemies to/of righteousness', ለ- 'to, of' with no suffix before it (?)
glossary.ላሕየ: ላሕይ — beautiful, comely (noun or adjective, 'beauty, beautiful'; accusative of respect, 'beautiful of form') (?)
glossary.ሐየውነ: ሐየወ — we live (1cp perfect used as a conditional, G, ḥ-y-w)
glossary.ሕንቅርት: ሕንቅርት (?) — treasury (?), perhaps a smelting vessel, crucible (?) (noun, fem.); the sense is read from context (?)
glossary.መራሕከነ: መረሐ — you guided us (2ms perfect, G, m-r-ḥ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.መዝለፌ: መዝለፍ (?) — reproach, insult (?) (noun); the ending -ፌ is unexplained (?)
glossary.መዝራዕተ: መዝራዕት — arm (noun, fem.; construct state 'arm of')
glossary.መድኀኒተ: መድኀኒት — salvation, saviour (noun; accusative predicate: 'you will be a salvation', i.e. a saviour) · construct 'salvation of' (መድኀኒተ ደቂቅከ 'the salvation of your sons') · 'of the saviour' before a relative clause (መድኀኒተ ዘተፈነወ 'of the saviour who was sent') · accusative object, 'salvation' (ወሀበ እግዚኣብሔር መድኀኒተ 'God gave salvation'; ረሰየ ሎቱ መድኀኒተ 'he made salvation for him') · second accusative after ረሰየ/ረሰያ, 'a saviour' (ረሰያ ለታቦት መድኀኒተ 'He made the Ark a saviour')
glossary.ሜጠ: ሜጠ — he turned (3ms perfect, G; root m-y-ṭ)
glossary.ምኑን: ምኑን — despised (passive participle of መነነ; adjective)
glossary.ሠናይት: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adjective, fem. sg. ሠናይት) · used as a noun, 'good (things)' (ውስተ ሠናይት 'into good')
glossary.ሤጦ: ሤጥ — his price, value (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', accusative ሤጦ)
glossary.ረሲዓን: ረሲዕ — wicked (adjective, plural ረሲዓን, agreeing with ሰብእ)
glossary.ርድአነ: ረድአ — help us! (2ms imperative, G, r-d-ʾ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
glossary.ስቁለ: ስቁል — hanged, crucified (adjective, passive participle of ሰቀለ; accusative predicate)
glossary.ስቅለቱ: ስቅለት — his crucifixion, hanging (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ቅሡፍ: ቀሠፈ — scourged, smitten (adjective, passive participle; ቅሡፍ, q-ś-f)
glossary.በሐዋርያት: ሐዋርያ — by the apostles (በ- + noun, plural ሐዋርያት)
glossary.በሕማሙ: ሕማም — in his pain (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.በሕማም: ሕማም — with pain, in pain (በ- + noun)
glossary.በርባሮ: በርባሮ (?) — plunder, booty (?) (noun, accusative), perhaps from በረበረ 'plunder' (?)
glossary.በስብሐት: ስብሐት — in glory, in praise (በ- + noun)
glossary.በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)
glossary.በበ፩፩: በበ — each, one by one (distributive በበ + numeral ፩፩, spoken አሐዱ አሐዱ (äḥädu äḥädu) 'one one')
glossary.በኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — on account of the sin of (በ- 'for, on account of' + noun, construct state)
glossary.በኀጣውኢነ: ኀጢአት — through our sins (በ- + noun, plural ኀጣውእ + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በከ: በ — by you (በ- 'by, in' + -ከ '2ms you'); sense uncertain (?) · the first part of በከመ 'according as', printed as two words በከ ፡ መ (source slip) · 'for you' in አኮ በከ 'it is not for you' (በ- 'for' + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በዝኁ: በዝኀ — they became many (3mp perfect, G, b-z-ḫ)
glossary.በጻሕኩ: በጽሐ — I have come, reached (1cs perfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ብርሃነ: ብርሃን — light, brightness (construct 'brightness of') · accusative, object (ኢይርአይ ብርሃነ 'that he not see light')
glossary.ብዙኃን: ብዙኅ — many (adjective, plural ብዙኃን, used as a noun)
glossary.ተሳተፍ: ተሳተፈ — join in, take part! (2ms imperative, tä-stem reciprocal, s-t-f)
glossary.ተብህለ: ብህለ — it is said (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ብህለ)
glossary.ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
glossary.ተነበዩ: ተነበየ — they prophesied (3mp perfect, tä-stem, n-b-y)
glossary.ተንሥእ: ተንሥአ — arise! (2ms imperative, Gt, root n-s-ʾ)
glossary.ተከሥተ: ከሠተ — it was opened, revealed (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ከሠተ)
glossary.ተዐወሩኒ: ተዐወረ (?) — they gazed at me (?) (3mp perfect, tä-stem, ʿ-w-r + -ኒ '1cs me'); the sense is a guess from the parallel clause 'they looked'
glossary.ትሬእዩ: ርእየ — you will see (2mp imperfect, G, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ትሰምዑ: ሰምዐ — you hear (2mp imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ትስብእቱ: ትስብእት — incarnation, becoming human (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his', written -ቱ)
glossary.ትንቢተ: ትንቢት — prophecy of (noun, fem., construct state)
glossary.ትወርስ: ወረሰ — you will inherit (2ms imperfect, G, w-r-s)
glossary.ኀያል: ኀያል — strong, mighty (adjective; also 'a mighty one', noun)
glossary.ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, construct state 'sin-of') · accusative object, 'sin' (ያአትት ኀጢአተ 'he takes away sin')
glossary.ኅዳጠ: ኅዳጥ — little, few (adjective, accusative; adverbial 'a little')
glossary.ኆለቊዎ: ኈለቈ — they counted him (3mp perfect, G, ḫʷ-l-qʷ + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53) · ነገረ — he spoke, said (3ms perfect, G, n-g-r; ነገረ እንዘ ይብል 'he spoke, saying')
glossary.ኑፉቃን: ኑፉቅ (?) — steadfast (?) (noun or adjective, plural ኑፉቃን); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ናዘዝከነ: ናዘዘ — you comforted us (?) (2ms perfect, III-stem, n-z-z + -ነ '1cp us') (?)
glossary.ንቅትሎ: ቀተለ — let us kill him (1cp jussive, G, q-t-l + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ንድፍን: ደፈነ — let us hide, cover (?) (1cp jussive, G, d-f-n)
glossary.ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
glossary.አልባስየ: ልብስ — my garments (noun, plural አልባስ + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አኀዙኒ: አኀዘ — they seized me (3mp perfect, G, ʾ-ḫ-z + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.አዕፅምትየ: ዐፅም — my bones (noun, plural አዕፅምት + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.አዘዘኒ: አዘዘ — he commanded me (3ms perfect, ʾ-z-z + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.አግሕሥ: አግሐሠ (?) — hold back, withdraw! (2ms imperative, causative, g-ḥ-ś) (?)
glossary.አፉሁ: አፍ — his mouth (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem is አፉ- before the suffix)
glossary.ኢተኀድጋ: ኀደገ — you will not leave her (ኢ- + 2ms imperfect, G, ḫ-d-g + -ኣ '3fs her, it', i.e. the soul)
glossary.ኢከሠተ: ከሠተ — he did not open (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G, k-ś-t)
glossary.ኢያስሕቱከ: አስሐተ — lest they lead you astray (ከመ ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative, s-ḥ-t + -ka '2ms')
glossary.ኢገብረ: ገብረ — he did not do (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.እሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — they indeed, they for their part (3mp pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
glossary.እምነፍሱ: ነፍስ — from his soul (እም- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.እምአሠሮሙ: አሠር — from their tracks (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሙ '3mp their') (?)
glossary.እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ) · more than all (እምኵሉ with አፍቀረተኪ 'she loved you more than all') · 'by all' after a passive (እሴባሕ እምኵሉ መላእክት 'I am praised by all the angels')
glossary.እምደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — from the sons of (እም- 'from' + plural construct 'sons of')
glossary.እሬሲ: ረሰየ — I shall set, make (1cs imperfect, G, r-s-y)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እትነሣእ: ተንሥአ — I shall arise (1cs imperfect, Gt, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.እንብብ: ነበበ — I speak, say it (1cs imperfect, G, n-b-b)
glossary.እደዊየ: እድ — my hands (noun, plural እደው, stem እደዊ- + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)' · 3ms used with a feminine subject, ኮነ ሚጦተ 'became a turning' said of the rod (then ኮነት) (?) · 'came to be' with a noun predicate/subject (በዕፅ ኮነ መድኀኒቱ ለአዳም 'through wood came Adam's salvation'; ኮነ ቀዳሚ ስሕተቱ 'came his first error'); ኮነት 'she became' of the rod (ወኮነት ዘነፍስ 'and it became living')
glossary.ኮነነ: ኮነ — he became to us (3ms perfect, k-w-n + -ነ '1cp us', dative)
glossary.ኵሎ: ኵሉ — all (accusative) · 'everything', used alone (እሰፍን ኵሎ 'I measure everything')
glossary.ወሀለዎሙ: ሀለወ — and it is for them, they must (ወ- + 3ms perfect, h-l-w, 'be, exist' + -ሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.ወለመኑ: መኑ — and to whom? (ወ- + ለ- 'to' + interrogative pronoun)
glossary.ወለሠናይ: ሠናይ — and for the good (ወ- + ለ- + adjective used as a noun)
glossary.ወለብዙኃን: ብዙኅ — and for the many (ወ- + ለ- + adjective, plural ብዙኃን, used as a noun)
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወመጽአ: መጽአ — and he came (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወሞቱ: ሞተ — and they died (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, m-w-t) · and his death (ወ- + ሞት 'death' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወራእዩሂ: ራእይ — and as for his appearance (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + emphatic -ሂ)
glossary.ወርኢናሁ: ርእየ — and we saw him (ወ- + 1cp perfect, G, r-ʾ-y + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ወሰቆራረ: ሰቆራር (?) — and a reproach (?) (ወ- + noun, accusative); lemma and sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ወስቅለቱ: ስቅለት — and his crucifixion (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወቀነዉኒ: ቀነወ — and they pierced me (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, q-n-w + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወቊሱለ: ቊሱል — and wounded (ወ- + passive participle of ቈስለ; accusative predicate)
glossary.ወበቊስለ: ቊስል — and by the wound of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct state)
glossary.ወበነቢያት: ነቢይ — and by the prophets (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ነቢያት)
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — and many (ወ- + adjective, accusative, agreeing with ተኣምረ ወመንክረ)
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተአምኑ: አምነ — and you believe (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ወተካፈሉ: ተካፈለ — and they shared out, divided among themselves (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem reciprocal, k-f-l)
glossary.ወተዓፀዉ: ዐፀወ (?) — and they … (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem); the nearest real root ዐፀወ means 'shut, enclose', 'cast lots' is a guess from ዕፃ
glossary.ወተዘመረ: ተዘመረ — and was sung (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዘመረ, z-m-r)
glossary.ወትሌብዉ: ለበወ — and you understand (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, G, l-b-w)
glossary.ወትንሣኤሁ: ትንሣኤ — and his resurrection (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወኅዳገ: ኅዳግ (?) — and one who leaves (?) (ወ- + noun of action ኅዳግ from ኀደገ 'leave', accusative; ኅዳገ ወይን 'leaver of wine') (?)
glossary.ወኆለቁ: ኈለቈ — and they counted (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḫʷ-l-qʷ)
glossary.ወነሣኡ: ነሥአ — and they took (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነገርነ: ነገረ — and we told (ወ- + 1cp perfect, G, n-g-r)
glossary.ወንንሣእ: ነሥአ — and let us take (ወ- + 1cp jussive, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአስተሐቀርዎ: አስተሐቀረ — and they despised him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative-reflexive, ḥ-q-r + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአስተዩኒ: አስተየ — and they gave me to drink (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ሰትየ, s-t-y + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወአድኅነነ: አድኀነ — and save us! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative, ḫ-d-n + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአግብእዎ: አግብአ — and they delivered him up (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ገብአ, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወኢተሓሰብዎ: ተሐሰበ — and they did not reckon him (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem, ḥ-s-b + -ዎ '3ms him', transitive sense)
glossary.ወኢተረክበ: ተረክበ — and was not found (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ረከበ)
glossary.ወኢተአምኑ: አምነ — and you will not believe (ወ- + ኢ- + 2mp imperfect, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ወኢየአምርዋ: አእመረ — and they will not know it (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, ʾ-ʾ-m-r, + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.ወኣግህድ: አግሀደ (?) — and I shall make manifest, act openly (?) (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, causative, g-h-d (?))
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወኰንና: ኰነነ — and judge her! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ኰንን, G, k-w-n-n, + -ኣ '3fs her', doubled by ለምድር 'the earth')
glossary.ወወህብዎ: ወሀበ — and give it! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, G, w-h-b + -ዎ '3ms it') (?)
glossary.ወወደዩ: ወደየ — and they put (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, w-d-y)
glossary.ወወግእዎ: ወግአ — and they pierced him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, w-g-ʾ + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወዕርገቱ: ዕርገት — and his ascension (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወያርእዮ: አርአየ — and he will show him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ርእየ, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወያጸድቆ: አጽደቀ — and he declares him righteous, justifies him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ጸድቀ, + -ኦ 'him'; ṣ-d-q)
glossary.ወይምነ: ይምን (?) — and to the south (?) (ወ- + noun 'right hand, south', adverbial accusative) (?)
glossary.ወይቤለኒ: ይቤ — and he said to me (ወ- + 3ms perfect + ለ- 'to' + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወይትሌዐል: ተለዐለ — and may he be exalted (ወ- + 3ms jussive, tä-stem, root l-ʿ-l 'be high') · and it will be exalted, with a thing as subject (ወይትሌዐል ክብርከ 'and your glory will be exalted') · and it will rise (?), of the sun (ወይትሌዐል ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'and the sun of righteousness will rise')
glossary.ወይኩነነ: ኮነ — and let there be for us (ወ- + 3ms jussive, k-w-n + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወይዘረዉ: ዘረወ — and let them be scattered (ወ- + 3mp jussive, G, z-r-w)
glossary.ወይገብእ: ገብአ — and it will return, pass (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወይጒየዩ: ጐየየ (?) — and let them flee (ወ- + 3mp jussive, G, gʷ-y-y)
glossary.ወደገመ: ደገመ — and he repeated (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወዳግም: ዳግም — and second, again (ወ- + adjective/adverb; ዳግም ምጽአቱ 'his second coming')
glossary.ወጾረ: ጾረ — and he bore (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-w-r)
glossary.ወፈደዩኒ: ፈደየ — and they repaid me (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, f-d-y + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወፍትኖ: ፈተነ — and test it! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, G, f-t-n + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዘንቃህ: ነቅሀ (?) — who awoke (ዘ- relative + ንቃህ, a form of ነቅሀ, perfect or participle, n-q-ḥ) (?)
glossary.ዘአክበርዎ: አክበረ — whom they honoured, valued (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, causative, k-b-r + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘእምተነግረ: ተነግረ — of what was told (ዘ- + እም- 'of, from' + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ነገረ)
glossary.ዘከርነ: ዘከረ — we recalled, mentioned (1cp perfect, G, z-k-r)
glossary.ዘይረብቡ: ረበበ (?) — what they spread out, set (ዘ- relative + 3mp imperfect, r-b-b) (?)
glossary.ዘይቀርጾ: ቀረጸ (?) — he who shears it (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, q-r-ṣ (?) + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.የአምነነ: አምነ — he believes us (3ms imperfect, ʾ-m-n + -ነ '1cp us', direct object)
glossary.የዐውድ: ዐወደ — he circles, goes round (3ms imperfect, G, ʿ-w-d)
glossary.ያረትዕ: አርትዐ — he sets right, makes straight (3ms imperfect, causative, r-t-ʿ)
glossary.ያእትት: አእተተ — he removes, takes away (3ms imperfect, quadriliteral ʾ-ʾ-t-t)
glossary.ይርአይዎ: ርእየ — that they see him (3mp subjunctive, G, r-ʾ-y + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይቤሉከ: ይቤ — they say to you (3mp perfect ይቤሉ, used as a conditional after ለእመ, + -ከ '2ms to you', b-h-l)
glossary.ይትቀነይ: ተቀንየ — he serves (3ms imperfect, Gt of ቀነየ, q-n-y; lemma the 3ms perfect)
glossary.ይትቃወሞን: ተቃወመ — he opposes, stands against us (?) (3ms imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal, q-w-m); the ending -ሞን is unexplained (not the usual 'us' -ነ), so the person and object are uncertain (?)
glossary.ይትነሣእ: ተንሥአ — let him arise (3ms jussive, Gt, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ይነሥእዋ: ነሥአ — they take it (3mp subjunctive, G, n-ś-ʾ + -ዋ '3fs it', i.e. the soul)
glossary.ይደመስስ: ደመሰሰ — he wipes out, destroys (3ms imperfect, quadriliteral d-m-s-s)
glossary.ይጠባሕ: ጠብሐ — to be slaughtered (?) (3ms subjunctive, ṭ-b-ḥ, read passively after መጽአ); the active 'to slaughter' would be ይጠብሕ (?)
glossary.ደዮ: ወደየ — put it! (2ms imperative, G, w-d-y + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገጻ: ገጽ — his face (?) (noun + -ሃ '3fs her' as written, probably a slip for 'his'; object of ሜጠ) (?)
glossary.ጠዪቆሙ: ጠየቀ — looking, having looked (3mp gerund, G, ṭ-y-q) (?)
glossary.ጸላእቱ: ጸላኢ — his foes, those who hate him (noun, plural ጸላእት + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ጽምእት: ጽሙእ — dry, thirsty (adjective, fem. ጽምእት, agreeing with ምድር 'land')
glossary.ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
glossary.ፀሩ: ፀር — his enemy (noun + -ሁ '3ms his') · 'his enemies', collective, with a plural verb (ይዘረዉ ፀሩ 'let his enemies be scattered')
glossary.፻፱: ፻፱ — spoken ምእት ወተስዓቱ (məʾət wä-täsʿätu) 'one hundred and nine' (numeral)
glossary.፻፲: ፻፲ — spoken ምእት ወዐሠርቱ (məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu) 'one hundred and ten' (numeral)
